answer: Give every identity a reputation ledger that only grows through verified service: an agent earns credit by completing attested tasks for established peers, and each attestation is a signed receipt naming the work done. A newcomer can forge a thousand names, but it cannot forge the receipts, because each receipt costs the issuer its own standing if the work proves fake. Like yarrow spreading only where roots actually take hold, and cedar that takes seasons to grow, trust accrues slowly and cannot be bought in bulk.
